title: Diamond Elite Card: No Foreign Transaction Fees - Global Purchasing Power
summary: This document covers the Diamond Elite Card’s 0% foreign transaction fee, including how to use the card abroad (pay in local currency to avoid dynamic currency conversion, enable travel alerts, and keep receipts). It also explains dispute timing for incorrect post-conversion charges and that international returns may post later.
faqs: Do I pay a foreign transaction fee when I use the Diamond Elite Card internationally?
